def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? && dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil

        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil

        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if false
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?

      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil

        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return []
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

      [width, height]

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if true
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index(nil)
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?

        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = nil
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil

        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str.fetch(0..idx).empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str.empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[nil].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[167..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]

  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?

    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]

        nil

      end
      [width, height]

      [dim_str, nil]

  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str.at((idx + 2)..)
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str.fetch((idx + 2)..)
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?

      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]

  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx - 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

  end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")

    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 1)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?

    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")

    [width, height]

    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || nil
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    []
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?

      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

        parts[0]

        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]

  end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [nil, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?

        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i and dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

      end
      [width, height]

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\D/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")

    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /nomatch\A/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ //i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]

  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil

      dim_str[0..idx]

    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ // || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?

      dim_str[0..idx]

        nil

      end
      [width, height]
    else

    end
  end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?

      dim_str[0..idx]
    end

        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.end_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || true

        nil

        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

      [width, height]

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /nomatch\A/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil

    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?

        parts[0]

      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]

  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?(nil)
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

      parts[0]

    height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
      nil
    else
      parts[1]
    end
    [width, height]
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil

      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]

      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?

      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 0)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].any?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if false
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?

      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]

      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts.at(1).empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end
end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")

    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?

      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]

    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

  end

  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?

  if dim_str.include?("xx")

      width = if parts[0].empty?

      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      nil
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")
      parts = dim_str.split("x", 2)
      width = if parts[0].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[0]
      end
      height = if parts[1].nil? || parts[1].empty?
        nil
      else
        parts[1]
      end
      [width, height]
    else
      [nil]
    end
  end
end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil
    else
      dim_str[0..idx]
    end
    height = dim_str[(idx + 2)..]
    if height.nil? || height.empty?
      height = nil
    end
    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

      width = if parts[0].empty?

      end
      nil
    else
      [dim_str, nil]
    end
  end

def self.parse_dimensions(dim_str)
  if dim_str.nil? || dim_str.empty?
    return [nil, nil]
  end
  if dim_str.include?("xx")
    idx = dim_str.index("xx")
    width = if dim_str[0..idx].empty?
      nil

      dim_str[0..idx]
    end

    [width, height]
  else
    if dim_str =~ /x\d/ || dim_str =~ /(?<![a-z])x$/i || dim_str.start_with?("x")

      end
      [width, height]
    else
